answer: Bring a payoff letter from Coastal Credit Union, since we compare it with our offer at the appointment, and bring a cashier's check or debit card to pay the difference. We no longer accept personal checks, and we don't accept credit cards. While your loan is open, the lender holds the title, so you don't need to bring it or get a duplicate. The help center refers to an appointment checklist but doesn't list what's on it, so please contact a store to confirm anything else you need.
